text:
Predicates:
NLPTask(x) ::: x is a natural language processing task.
LanguageGenerationTask(x) ::: x is a language generation task.
LanguageUnderstandingTask(x) ::: x is a language understanding task.
OutputTextSequence(x) ::: the output of x is a text sequence.
Premises:
∀x (NLPTask(x) → (LanguageGenerationTask(x) ⊕ LanguageUnderstandingTask(x))) ::: Natural language processing tasks can be categorized as either language generation task or language understanding task.
∀x (NLPTask(x) ∧ OutputTextSequence(x) → LanguageGenerationTask(x)) ::: If the output of a natural language processing task is a text sequence, then it is a language generation task.
NLPTask(machineTranslation) ::: Machine translation is a natural language processing task.
OutputTextSequence(machineTranslation) ::: The output of machine translation is a text sequence.
Conclusion:
LanguageGenerationTask(machineTranslation) ::: Machine translation is a language generation task.
